notes.title: Dreams in the Witch House - Update now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dreamers!

We are thrilled to announce that update 1.06 for Dreams in the Witch House is now available on Steam! This update brings a range of changes and improvements based on your feedback to enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/546ae9dcdf931237225f90eb1dd2074872d321e0.png[/img]

Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Walter can now buy the rat poison directly from the general store, if he has discussed poisoning the rats with Joe.
[*] Earplugs can now deteriorate completely only after sleeping, resting, or studying at home.
[*] An option has been added to disable tutorial texts when starting a new game.
[*] When hovering over an inventory item, the description text will now show how many copies/doses it has.
[*] The Special Collection ending dialog with Armitage now takes into account Walter's Occult skill value.
[*] Occult skill value can no longer be negative.
[*] An issue where it was possible to sign the book of Azathoth several times has been fixed.
[*] An issue where eating canned food at the dream city could decrease Walter's food amount when he is awake has been fixed.
[*] An issue where a corridor exit hotspot could be visible in the dream city, even if the way was blocked, has been fixed.
[*] All mentions of Sarah Churchwell are corrected to Sarah Churchill in the witch trial documents.
[*] If the university basement pipe is burst, Armitage's Special Collection intro sequence can no longer happen in any scenario.
[*] An issue in the Elwood intro sequence where Elwood's sprite might have disappeared briefly has been fixed.
[*] An issue where Elwood could have been incorrectly tinted when encountering him on the street has been fixed.
[*] If the game is paused by pressing spacebar in the index card close-up room, right-clicking no longer freezes the game.
[*] Looking at the strange rod in inventory while in a close-up room no longer freezes the game.
[*] Minor typo fixes have been made.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback, which have helped us identify and address these issues. If you encounter any further problems or have any suggestions, please let us know.

Enjoy the game, and may your dreams be filled with wonder and horror!

-rongel

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902850/Dreams_in_the_Witch_House/

notes.title: END OF YEAR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello!

So as you may already know, Bonus Stage Publishing is helping me to finish the game and spread the word. Feels very nice to have people around me who have done this before!

This change delayed the release a bit, and the new date is in early 2023. The good thing is that I now have a little bit of extra time to polish the game. So here's couple of new special things that have been added already:

[list]
[*] DIFFICULTY LEVELS
There's now three difficulty levels to choose from. They don't affect the puzzles, but change how the survival / RPG stuff works. There's even Ironman mode, if you want extra tension and avoid save scumming.

[*] TWO NEW MUSIC TRACKS
More great music from Troy Sterling Nies that add atmosphere in the game.

[*] CHARACTER BAR STATUS PROGRESSION SYMBOLS
The lines below show the progress to the next status phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/27e90e3fca819420d5998c52b6a713679e054294.png[/img]
This will hopefully make protecting Walter easier. This feature was a suggestion from a player of the demo, so I can't take all the credit :)

[*] BETTER TUTORIALS AND INSTRUCTIONS
New players should have an easier time figuring out how things work. For example, finding study books should now be more intuitive.
[/list]
Before I leave, here's a previously unpublished picture from the game. I can reveal that it is not the ending. I'm not going to spoil that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/a1b978a104b726b1086f314d607732003a51e010.png[/img]

Take care, talk to you soon!

- Antti

notes.title: AUTUMN UPDATE

notes.title: DEMO 1.05 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Next Fest is now over, and I want to thank everyone who played / commented / wishlisted the game!

A couple of new bugs were reported during the festival, so this 1.05 update addresses them. This will probably be the last update for the demo, unless something significant comes up. Now the work on the full version continues!

CHANGELOG:

- Fixed the crash when Mrs. Dombrowski leaves Walter's room after cleaning it
- Fixed Walter's comment when pressing the "CANCEL" button at the Photography Store
- "Task completed" text now only comes up once when Walter closes the rathole
- Fixed Walter's placement in the Downtown, so that he doesn't get stuck when the Paperboy spawns in the morning
- Map hotkey disabled when in the main menu
- Default graphics driver changed to OpenGL 
- Wrong exam answer penalty reduced to 0.5 points (was 1.0 points)

Save games from version 1.04 are compatible, EXCEPT that the time of day will be reseted to dawn. In some special situations this could cause problems, but reloading the room should fix them. If you wish to keep using the previous 1.04 version, you can enable it in Steam library: Properties -> Betas -> 1.04

Thanks!

Antti 
Atom Brain Games

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE + STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is just around the corner! So here's a new, polished version of Dreams in the Witch House demo for the event. And this time Linux Proton / Wine users can join the fun! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/3eca561a4e5e0245f65f73fd49843c13a04f7ce3.png[/img]

CHANGELOG 1.04

- Support for Linux Proton / Wine
- Halved the time progression speed when in real-time. Now one real-time minute is 30 minutes in game
- Stopwatch symbol now shows all the paused situations
- Made a story object in Joe's room easier to spot
- Joe can now have planks for the rat hole
- Starting Math skill now 1.0
- Added 1 portion of food to starting items
- Edited Character Bar descriptions for Coldness and Wetness to be more informative
- Changed Coffee House button text from "Lunch" to "Meal"
- Added a couple of new comments for Walter when interacting with certain items
- New save game slot now empty (no need to delete the previous text) 
+ some minor fixes / adjustments

Save games from version 1.03 are compatible, except some of the timers (Hunger, Tiredness etc...) will be reseted to zero. It shouldn't cause a noticeable impact. If you prefer to use the previous 1.03 version, you can enable it in Steam library: Properties -> Betas -> 1.03

Thanks & have a great weekend!

-Antti
